book.name: HECHOS
book.title: Jesuspa Cachran Ruragcuna Rurapäcunganpita Isquirbisha Libru

content: Pablo Macedoniapawan Greciapa aywangan

Chay runacuna nä wichicaruptinga, Pabloga gayarun Jesusman yupachicugcunatam imanuy cawapäcunanpagsi rimapänanpag. Nä ali cawapäcunanpag rimaparcurga aywacura Macedoniapam lapalanta “Aywalärag” nircur.
Chay Macedoniaman chrarurga, purira marcan marcanmi Jesusman yupachicugcunata Jesús ningannuy ali cawapäcunanpag rimapayar. Jinaypam chrarura Grecia ningancama.

Chay Greciachru yachrara quima quillaran. Chaypitam Siriata aywananpag büquiman jegananpag nä cayaptin, musyarärichin Israel castacuna wanuchiy munapäcunganta. Chaymi Pabloga chraquilapa Macedoniapa cutira.

Chay aywaptin paywan aywapäcura cay runacunam; Sópater jutiyog runam (payga cara Berea marcapitam), Pirro jutiyog runapa churin. Chaypitam aywapäcura Aristarcowan Segundo. Paycuna capäcura Tesalonicapitam, nätan Gayom Derbe marcapita, jinaman Timoteom, Tïquicom, Tröfimom Asia ninganpita.
Chay runacunaga naupacurcaram. Jinarcurmi shuyapäcamara Troas marcachru.

Nätan nogacunaga Pablowan mana levaduraynag tanta micuy fiesta usharuptinga, aywapäcurä Filipospitaga büquiwanmi. Chaypitaga pichga junagtam tincurärï chay naupata aywag runacunawanga Troaschru. Chaychru capäcurä ganchris junagran.
Pablo Troaschru yachrachingan

Jinarcurmi sábadu warantin gotucapäcurä Jesús wanunganta tanta micuypa, vïnuta upyaypa yarpapäcunäpag. Chaychrümi nä warantin aywacunan captin Pabloga yachrachira Jesusman yupachicugcunata chraupi pagascama.
Nätan goturapäcurä juc wayipa quimacag altusninchrümi. Chaychrüga achcam cara achquicuna.

Chauraga Eutico jutiyog mözum tayayara ventänachru. Jinarcurmi Pablo mana wayrala rimayta ushaptinga, mözutaga alisca pununarun. Chaura awill awillyar punuyanganchrümi ishquirun chay goturarcayangä altuspita pampaman. Chaura sharcachipäcamunanpagga wanusham cayänag.
Chaura Pabloga altuspita aywarcurmi wanusha mözucagman chrarurga macalicurun. Jinarcurmi “Ama manchacapäcuychu. ¡Cawayanmi!” nirun.
Chaypita Pabloga yapay altusman jegarcurga, tantatam, vïnutam aypuräriman Jesús wanunganta yarpachracurcänäpag. Nä micucurcurga yapaymi yachrachira pacha waraycama. Chaypitaran aywacura.
Nätan chay mözu ishquigtaga wayinta aywachipäcura cawayagtam. Lapan runacunam chaychru cagcunaga quëdarärin alisca cushishacama.
Troaspita Miletota Pablo aywangan
Chaypita nogacunaga naupacurcarä büquiwanmi Asoncama. Nätan Pablom aywamura chraquilapa Asoncama. Chay Asonchru shuyapäcunäpagmi rimanacurcasha capäcurä.
Nä Pablowan Asonchru tincurärirga, paywan aywacurcarä büquiman jegarcurmi Mitileneta.

Chaypita aywarmi warantinga, chrarärï Quío tishgo chimpanman. Chaypita aywar warantinga chrarärï Samosmantan. Jinarcurmi Trogilioman chrarurga jamapäcurcarä. Chaypita aywar warantinga chrarärï Miletomanmi.

Nätan büquiwan aywapäcurä Pablo chaynuypa pinsiasha captinmi. Payga Efesoman chrayta mana munarachu Asiachru mana quëdayta munarmi. Antis payga chrayta munara Jerusalenchru ‘Pentecostés’ ningan fiestapagmi.
Efesopita gayachingancunata Pablo rimapangan
Chauraga chay Miletochru cayarmi, Pablo gayachimura Efesopita Jesusman yupachicug gotucagcunachru mandagcunata.
Nä chrarärimuptinga cay niram: “Gamcuna musyarcayanquim Asiaman chrämungäpita-pacha imanuy gamcunacagchru cawangätas.
Chaynuylam lapan junagsi gamcunawan yachrar, Munayniyog Diosta servirä mana olgotucular, nätan maymay wagarchri casha cä Israel-mayïcuna ima-aygatas lutan rurayta munapäcamaptin.
Chaynuylam gamcunata yachrachipäcurag imatas alicagtaga, Diospag ali cawapäcunaypag. Yachrachipäcuragmi lapan runa ricaysi, nätan wayiquicunachrüsi.
Nogaga Israel castacunatas juc castacunatas nisham cä jucha rurayanganta wanacurcur Diosman cutipäcunanpag, jinaman Munayniyog Jesucristoman yupachicurcänanpag.
Cananga aywayä Jerusalentam Santu Espíritu aywachimaptin. Manam musyächu wacchru ima pasamänantas.
Nätan wac Jerusalenman chraruptï, carcelman yaycunäpitam, jinaman alisca cunchunäpitam ichaga Santu Espirituga musyayächiman mayag chayag marcaman chraptïsi.

Nätan chaynuy nimangancuna manam laquicachimanchu. Imanuysi cashag, wanursi cawarsi taytanchita servishag pay munangannuy jinaman Munayniyog Jesús nimanganta rurayta ushashag. Payga nogata nirayäman Dios cuyacug canganta pitas maytas willapacunäpagmi.
Gamcunataga Diospa munayninchru imanuy cawapäcunaypagsi shumagmi yachrachipäcurag, nätan cananpita nä manam masta ricapapäcamanquichu.
Chauraga shumag mayapäcamay: Cananpitaga nä gamcunapitachr imanuysi cacurcanqui, nogaga manam juchayogchu cä.
Nogaga yachrachipäcurag Dios ningancunataga lapantam.

Chaura cananpitaga gamcunas cuidacurcay, jinaman Jesusman lapan yupachicugcunatas cuidapäcuy. Gamcunataga paycuna cuidag, jinaman mandag capäcunaypagmi Santu Espíritu chrurararcayäshunqui, nätan paycuna raygom Munayniyog Jesuspis yawarninta jichrar wanura.
Nä aywacuptïga fijum gamcunaman aywamunga lutan yachrachig runacuna, uyshacunata micunanpag atogcuna aymugnuysi.

Chay casqui yachrachigcunaga gamcunalapitam yargapäcamunga. Chay yachrachigcunaga razoncagta yachrachipäcunan trucam yachrachipäcunga lutanta, Jesuspa discïpuluncuna paycunanuysi lutanta rurayar cawapäcunanpag.
Chauraga mayag mayaglam capäcunqui, nogaga quima watantinmi pagaspas junagpas gamcunata wagaparcur wagaparcur lapaytas yachrachipäcurag. Chaura chayta yarpapäcuy.

Chaura Jesusman yupachicug-mayïcuna, cananga Tayta Dios cachipäcushunqui, jinaman cuyapämarlanchi yanapäcug Jesuspa ali willapan ningannuy cawapäcuy. Chaynuy cawapäcurga Dioslapag cawagcuna chrasquipäcunanta gamcunas chrasquipäcunquim.
Manam nogaga pipa golguentas, öruntas ni jacuntas charirächu, ‘Cayga nogapag cachun’ nirsi.
Antismi gamcunaga shumag musyarcayanqui imatas rantinäpag maquïwan uryangätas, jinaman nogawan cagcunapag uryangätas.

Chaynuypam ima-aygachrüsi yachrachipäcurag gamcunas noganuy uryapäcunaypag, jinaman mana imaynag runacunatas yanapapäcunaypag. Yarpapäcuy Munayniyog Jesús cay ninganta: ‘Alisca cushisham cayan gogcunaga chrasquiyla chrasquigcunapitaga’ ”.
Chaynuypa nircurmi Pablo gongorpacuyur lapan chaychru cag runacunawan Diosta manacurcara.
Chauraga lapanmi alisca wagacurcan. Jinarcurmi Pablota macalicurcur muchapäcura.
Alisca laquisham capäcura “Manam yapayga ricapapäcamanquichu” niruptin. Chaypitam pay büquiman nä aywaptinga “Aywalärag” nipäcura lapalan.
